name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The candidate includes three redundant Existence clauses (blocker_moved, has_door_key, door_open) that are already forced by the hard Precedence chain ending in the hard Existence(target_picked_up). Specifically: Existence(door_open) and Existence(has_door_key) are forced by the chain Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) -> Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) + Existence(target_picked_up); Existence(blocker_moved) is forced by Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open) + the forced door_open. The compiler explicitly flags these as redundant. Remove all three redundant Existence clauses and keep only the Precedence clauses and the final hard Existence(target_picked_up).

texts: The blocking ball must no longer prevent access to the locked door before the door is opened.
The agent must be carrying the key matching the locked door before the door is opened.
The door leading to the target room must be currently unlocked and open before the agent is carrying the mission's designated box.
The agent must pick up the mission's designated box.
